request: Investigate why order ORD-1004 is late.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, and warehouse before deciding next steps.
I will retrieve the shipment tracking to determine current status, any delay reason, and whether the carrier updated the ETA.
I will check for Lone Star Parcel service alerts around Little Rock, AR to see if a disruption explains the stalled tracking.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1004 is overdue by 6 days. The shipment’s tracking has not updated since 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR, and the carrier has not provided a delay reason or updated ETA.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1004 fulfillment_status SHIPPED from WH-DAL; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-10; ship_by_date 2026-03-05.

get_shipment_status: SHP-5004 via Lone Star Parcel tracking LSP-40417 status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-05; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-10; is_overdue true, days_past_promised_date 6; last_event_date 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR; days_since_last_event 9; recorded_delay_reason null; current_estimated_delivery_date null.
get_carrier_alerts: Lone Star Parcel alerts for Little Rock, AR as of 2026-03-16 — none found (alert_count 0).
arguments.likely_cause: Tracking stalled at Little Rock, AR since 2026-03-07 with no recorded delay reason or matching carrier alert.
uncertainties: Underlying reason for the stall is unknown (no delay reason recorded).
Actual current location of the shipment and a confirmed new ETA are not yet available.

recommended_actions.details: Open a trace with Lone Star Parcel for tracking LSP-40417 to obtain current location, reason for no scans since 2026-03-07 in Little Rock, AR, and a confirmed ETA; cite get_shipment_status showing days_since_last_event 9, is_overdue true by 6 days, current_estimated_delivery_date null, and recorded_delay_reason null.

Inform Fabrikam Foods that ORD-1004 is delayed beyond the 2026-03-10 promise; last known movement was 2026-03-07 in Little Rock, AR; advise that we have requested a carrier trace and will update them with the confirmed ETA once received (per get_shipment_status and get_carrier_alerts showing no active alerts).

arguments.recommendation: Contact Lone Star Parcel immediately for a trace and ETA, and notify the customer of the delay and that an update is pending.
